import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p=params
    s0=np.sqrt(t); sP=np.sqrt(P); lt=np.log(t)
    return (p[0]*s0 + p[1]*s0*sP + p[2]*s0*P
            + lt*(p[3]+p[4]*P+p[5]*P**2)
            + p[6] + p[7]*P + p[8]*P**2 + p[9]*P**3)
